prompt:
Loop 047 — bounded medium static live-readiness evidence inventory / blocker worklist.

Goal:
Create a deterministic, side-effect-free inventory layer that turns the already accepted live-readiness proof categories into an explicit worklist of unresolved evidence. This is NOT a live-readiness authorizer and must not resolve or infer any real blocker.

Read first:
- src/providers/live_readiness.py
- src/providers/live_readiness_bundle.py
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_CONTRACT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_BUNDLE.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md

Allowed files only:
- src/providers/live_readiness_inventory.py
- tests/relay/test_live_readiness_inventory.py
- schemas/relay_live_readiness_inventory_v1.schema.json
- tests/relay/test_live_readiness_inventory_schema.py
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_INVENTORY.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Required design:
1. Pure/static only. No os.environ, filesystem I/O in production code, subprocess, network, provider process, API, model, credential, billing, settings, GitHub access, time, randomness, or hidden state.
2. Reuse COMMON_PROOFS and PROVIDER_PROOFS from live_readiness.py as the canonical proof-category source. Do not duplicate those category lists manually.
3. Exact provider order: openai, anthropic, google.
4. Provide a deterministic empty/current-worklist builder whose default inventory marks every required proof as UNKNOWN with evidence_ref=null. Never manufacture evidence.
5. Inventory proof record shape must be exact and machine-readable:
   - status: UNKNOWN or CONFIRMED only
   - evidence_ref: null when UNKNOWN; non-empty string when CONFIRMED
   No extra proof-record fields.
6. Validate/normalize an explicitly supplied inventory. Exact three providers only; exact proof keys per provider; no missing/extra keys. Malformed types, unknown statuses, UNKNOWN with non-null evidence_ref, CONFIRMED without a non-empty evidence_ref, non-JSON-serializable values, or caller mutation must fail closed.
7. Output may report only inventory/worklist state, never live authorization. Suggested aggregate states:
   - UNRESOLVED
   - PROOF_RECORDS_COMPLETE
   Even PROOF_RECORDS_COMPLETE means only that proof records are syntactically complete; it MUST NOT imply provider readiness.
8. Every output regardless of state:
   live_ready=false
   dispatch_allowed=false
   human_approval_required=true
   retry_count=0
   fallback_state=disabled
9. Include deterministic unresolved_by_provider mapping and unresolved_count. Proof names in deterministic order: sorted common categories first, then sorted provider-specific categories, or another explicitly documented deterministic rule.
10. Include canonical SHA-256 over the output payload excluding packet_sha256 itself, using sort_keys=true, compact separators, UTF-8. Equivalent semantic input with different dict key order must hash identically.
11. On malformed input return a fail-closed UNRESOLVED output with no claim that any proof is confirmed. Do not preserve unserializable/unsafe input in output.
12. Add a pure Japanese renderer that shows unresolved counts and proof category names only. It MUST NOT echo evidence_ref strings, URLs, secrets, raw proof payloads, or arbitrary untrusted status text.
13. Add a helper that converts a valid inventory into the exact per-provider proofs mapping expected by evaluate_live_readiness ONLY when every record is CONFIRMED. If any proof remains UNKNOWN or inventory is malformed, conversion must fail closed (return no proofs / explicit blocked result), not partially populate.
14. The helper must not call evaluate_live_readiness, provider preflight, bundle construction, or any external process. It only prepares explicit proof mappings.
15. JSON schema: draft 2020-12, additionalProperties=false at fixed layers, exact provider set, exact proof record shape/status rules where practical, fixed safety fields, aggregate state enum only UNRESOLVED/PROOF_RECORDS_COMPLETE, packet_sha256 lowercase 64 hex.
16. Tests in unittest-discover form:
   - empty builder returns all UNKNOWN and exact unresolved count
   - each provider has exactly COMMON_PROOFS | PROVIDER_PROOFS[provider]
   - one CONFIRMED proof reduces unresolved_count by exactly 1
   - all synthetic CONFIRMED records yield PROOF_RECORDS_COMPLETE but still live_ready=false/dispatch_allowed=false
   - missing/extra provider/proof keys fail closed
   - malformed status/evidence_ref combinations fail closed
   - non-JSON-serializable input fails closed
   - caller/source/result mutation isolation
   - equivalent key order gives identical digest
   - changing one evidence_ref changes digest
   - Japanese renderer never contains evidence_ref
   - conversion helper returns exact proof mappings only for all-CONFIRMED inventory and refuses partial inventory
   - AST/static proof of no ambient I/O/network/process/time/random surface
   - schema stdlib tests for constants/enums/additionalProperties/exact provider structure and no live authorization state strings
17. Documentation must state current real-world inventory remains unresolved/UNKNOWN; synthetic CONFIRMED tests do not resolve real blockers; this is a worklist/checklist layer only.
18. Update RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT as PREPARED/static evidence-inventory machinery only. Do not claim any real proof confirmed.
19. No workflow changes, no live probe, no provider/model/API call, no secret access, no billing/settings/permissions changes, no Merge.

Run focused tests, then exactly once:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publish the normal Jules PR from the isolated work branch if green. Do not merge.
